---
title: "Code to deidentify data downloaded from Qualtrics"
author: "Natalie Sarmiento (sarmien2@stanford.edu)"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Reading in the csv downloaded from Qualtrics
rawData <- read.csv('/users/nataliework/Downloads/psych251/sarmien22026/data/raw/qualtrics-raw.csv')

# removing additional rows added by qualtrics and sensitive metadata, keeping Finished
# for the exclusion rule
cleanedData <- rawData[-c(1:2),] %>%
  select(-c(StartDate:Last.Seen.Question.IDs), Finished)

# shuffling the order of participants and assigning new participant ids to each of them
# (the seed keeps the same ids every time this file is run on the same export)
set.seed(251)
cleanedData <- cleanedData[sample(nrow(cleanedData)),] %>%
  rowid_to_column(var = "participant_ID") 

# creating a participant key to link participant IDs to prolific IDs
prolificIDs <- cleanedData %>% select(participant_ID, ProlificID)

# removing Prolific IDs from the data that will be used for analysis
cleanedData <- cleanedData %>% select(-c(ProlificID)) 

# labelling the assigned condition from the Condition embedded data field set in the
# Qualtrics randomizer (1 = manipulation, 2 = control)
if (!"Condition" %in% names(cleanedData)) {
  stop("No Condition column: this export predates the Condition embedded data field.")
}

cleanedData <- cleanedData %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    Condition == 1 ~ "Intervention",
    Condition == 2 ~ "Control"
    )) %>%
  select(-Condition)




# creating new csv files to add to the repo
write.csv(cleanedData, '/users/nataliework/Downloads/psych251/sarmien22026/data/cleaned-data.csv')

write.csv(prolificIDs, '/users/nataliework/Downloads/psych251/sarmien22026/data/raw/participants.csv')

```
